item.content:encoded:
This is all very good, but the image seems very odd.

I can see two faint, very large eyes in the background, one very human-like, but that's about it. That's fairly ominous if I'm taking the size of the skeleton in the foreground to be a comparison, but otherwise, it's a lot tamer than other SCPs. I'd suggest trying to find a way to make it more nasty looking.

Additionally, while the skeleton not looking like a skeleton could add to the horror of "that thing means business when it kills", the clothing seems weird. Why is a US Navy sailor wearing light purple? Is he tangled in a vine, or in brightly colored civilian clothes, despite being military personnel?

As for the other bit in the picture, I am not quite sure if that's a claw with two red eyes, or two insects and an interesting looking tree branch. There are also three white dots behind it. Are those the creature's eyes?

In general, I think the image could use a rework to show clearly what the monster/entity could be, and cloth the skeleton more appropriately.

item.title: STAFF POST OPEN- Crosslink Proposal
item.content:encoded:
The WikiWalk team is proposing edits to this page. All proposed edits will be in a collapsible below this post, and after 7 days if there are no serious objections to the edits, the feedback received will be taken into account as the edits are made. If you have questions not directly related to the article about this project, please pm a member of the WikiWalk Team.

Show Reasoning
Hide Reasoning

Crosslink being proposed due to SCP-930's similarity to SCP-1372 in that both are islands, guarding or preceding something terrible in an isolated region.

Editing this:

SCP-930 is a tropical island located at 22.██████°S, 134.██████°W, formerly known as ██████████ by the local populace.

To this:

SCP-930 is a tropical island located at 22.██████°S, 134.██████°W, formerly known as ██████████ by the local populace.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Forgive me, but I feel I'm not expressing myself clearly.

The following facts are assumed:

  • Rocks attack vessels approaching the island.
  • Birds will cause superficial injury to individuals on or approaching the Island.
  • Individuals die or go missing on the island.
  • There is some sort of entity on the island.

Given these facts, a lost, confused seaman, likely suffering from hunger, thirst and sleep deprivation, has come to the conclusion that the birds are there explicitly to protect humans.

Given the same facts, I, as a reader, do not infer the same thing. My reading of this SCP gives me a different impression of it's purpose than the impressions of characters in it. Although this, in and of itself, is not necessarily a bad thing, for me it doesn't work in this instance.

item.content:encoded:
As I've said to you on IRC, the article feels like a skeleton despite its content.

I do think an armed/armoured team of Foundation agents exploring the island to figure out what's living there would add more value to the article as a whole. Something that would make the reader feel “Damn, I'm so glad it's stuck on an island. Totally warrants the artillery fire mentioned in the containment procedures.” without being too over the top. Just something to think about.

Edit: I think the comparison I want to make is with The Architect. By itself, you know everything you need to know about 184 but you just sit there wanting more. Then BAM, the exploration log hits you. It only gives you a glimpse of its capabilities and the beginning of the events that occured in its retrieval mission. No need to go into extra detail explaining what it is, just give us a loooong taste without actually being arbitrarily vague.

I'm afraid I have to downvote, I'm not seeing what other people are seeing in this. A bunch of birds on an island trying to drive people away from a mystery thing is just not very interesting or frightening. The twist that the birds are trying to "protect" people by driving them away is a little too hard to believe. I mean I can understand a survivor having that impression but that's just silly.

The mystery predator is the main danger here and it's hardly discussed at all. It's a standard boogeyman only it attracts birds who try to contain it themselves.

Wait, that is it! The birds are making their own birdy little Foundation. Secure, Contain, Peck.

No wait that is seriously terrible.
